brain.line: Living Brain holds three of our brains: the Grand Prix build, 123 pages; the Wattness Terminal, 18; Desert Willow's review, 1.
Combined into one team brain of 142 pages. Each brain keeps its own.
Living Brain linked them: 55 connections across brains, 43 build to Terminal, 12 build to review. One conflict flagged: two counts, and both hold.
Inside the Grand Prix brain: 34 build notes, compiled into 123 pages and 276 connections, 107 of them strong.
Page 02, Battery Tab: what the Battery tab shows, linked to 20 pages in its brain.
Across brains it links to the Terminal's Battery Page and to Desert Willow's review: 5 more, 2 of them strong.

Remember: at 10:58 CT, Desert Willow's hedge review went into its brain. Retrieve: a fresh session's answer now cites that page. A read as of the plan's 09:12 CT cutoff admits nothing, and the plan read no memory.
The same brain in Living Brain's own interface, where pages are called memories: 123, with 276 connections.
